steps.body: Customary units use their own factors — not tens. A foot is 12 inches, a yard is 3 feet, a pound is 16 ounces, a gallon is 4 quarts. The direction rule still holds: bigger unit to smaller, multiply. 3 feet = 3 × 12 = 36 inches.

widget.prompt: 3 ft = ? in. Customary factors aren't tens — the gearing here is 12.
widget.fallbackFeedback: A foot holds 12 inches, so the crossing multiplies: 3 × 12 = 36 in.
widget.successFeedback: 36 in. Different factor, same rule: the direction comes from which unit is bigger.

predict.prompt: Feet to inches uses ×12 instead of ×10 or ×1000. What actually changes about the crossing?

options.label: only the factor — the direction rule is the same
the direction — customary units convert by dividing
both the factor and the direction

predict.reveal: The rule survives the factor swap: bigger unit to smaller unit still multiplies. Customary units just use their own gear sizes — 12, 3, 4, 16 — instead of tens.

explanationVariants: Each pound holds 16 ounces, so 2 lb is 32 oz.

commonErrors.feedback: 8 uses 4 per pound, but a pound is 16 ounces: 2 × 16 = 32 oz.

steps.body: Going from a smaller unit up to a bigger one, divide. 48 ounces in pounds: 48 ÷ 16 = 3 lb. Same as before — down the ladder multiply, up the ladder divide — only the factor changes with each pair of units.

explanationVariants: Each pound is 16 oz, so 48 oz makes 3 lb.

commonErrors.feedback: 768 multiplies (48 × 16). Going up to a bigger unit divides: 48 ÷ 16 = 3 lb.

widget.prompt: 2 gal = ? qt. A small gear this time: 4.
widget.successFeedback: 8 qt — small factor, same crossing rule.

options.label: 3 ft
options.feedback: Right — going up to a bigger unit divides: 36 ÷ 12 = 3 ft.

options.label: 432 ft
options.feedback: 432 multiplies (36 × 12). in→ft goes to a BIGGER unit, so divide: 3 ft.

options.label: 24 ft
options.feedback: 24 subtracts 12. To convert in→ft, divide: 36 ÷ 12 = 3 ft.

explanationVariants: Each yard is 3 feet, so 5 yd is 15 ft.

commonErrors.feedback: 2 divides, but yd→ft goes to a smaller unit, so multiply: 5 × 3 = 15 ft.

takeaways: Customary factors: 1 ft = 12 in, 1 yd = 3 ft, 1 lb = 16 oz, 1 gal = 4 qt.
Bigger unit to smaller: multiply. Smaller to bigger: divide.
Use the right factor for each pair of units.

concept.body: Quick rewind. **Bigger unit → smaller multiplies; smaller → bigger divides — with the right factor.** 1 ft = 12 in, so 4 ft = 4 × 12 = 48 in. And 24 in = 24 ÷ 12 = 2 ft. Pick the factor for the units, then choose the direction.

commonErrors.feedback: 32 uses 8 per foot, but a foot is 12 inches: 4 × 12 = 48 in.
